source: Firebase Test Lab physical Android benchmark
scope: In-app CPU processing, excludes network/audio capture/playback; one execution per build, six seconds timed input each

verified.scope: Individual in-app FP32 CPU pushes; not remote-stream, call, microphone or end-to-end audio latency

cases.startupScope: First 640-sample push after fixture validation, reset and warmUp; not cold app startup

result.environmentScope: Physical Android device CPU processing; excludes network and audio-device latency
result.statistics: Nearest-rank percentiles of individual steady push calls
result.rtfDefinition: Sum of steady push call times / timed input audio duration; excludes setup, warmup, checks, memory sampling and finish
result.inputDescription: Continuous deterministic 173/317/911 Hz tones plus seeded xorshift noise; no recordings
